lane: STEWARD-HBM/COLL-LP (10-21): ROWS-256 copy of spec_q3_ars.json (HBM-ELEMOWN3/COLLQ3 (10-19; SAFE successor of TW2-COLLAR (10-19; from PL-COLLQ (PARENTS-LANDED 10-18))))
why: Native census found unbounded landing counter and payload controls. Opt in to existing bounded 24-bit autonomous rings and same-depth reset forest with private child leaves; preserve D4/E2 and all compiler/port ages. STEWARD-HBM/COLL-LP 10-21: the die binds hb_coll_* = v8x/v8g #(AR_ITER 1, ROWS 256) (RS(144) as one programme = 218 rows > 128; TOK-FUNC-HBM-XDIE 10-21 09:26). Same regions / landings / pin regs / in_regs / out_regs as spec_q3_ars; ONLY the issuer leaf (ot_hgi_coll_issuer_m256v8, CLOSED hcoll_issuer_r256v8_grid-grid-95a231167, 8-bit pc) and the fj leaf (<fj>_r256, ot_hgi_coll_safe_leaves_r256.sv) change. Predecessor: COLLQ3 SAFE successor (ar128 gates FAILED 10-19 08:58: CTS 'OT_HYBRID: CTS source ck_sw must reach only standard-cell clock pins' = 14 raw SRAMs (issuer 6, link_e 2x4) in the soft sw glue; ck_sw 76.4k soft flops (issuer 21.5k, reduce 21.2k, links 13.3k, fj 4.6k); unlanded-link FAIL from the 5-bit {5{ck_sw}} link clock pin read as 'no region'; rc_tag pin -> u_control 540 um combinational). Flat parent ot_hfd_coll_q3_lpf_ars (gen_coll_q2_lpf.py --safe): issuer / fj / link_e1 x2 / reduce lanes x16 are HARD children (one scalar clock pin each, SRAMs inside), reduce control u_rdc soft; sw soft mass ~16k (upipe 1.9k, vmasm 4.3k, reduce ctl ~0.8k, landing rings ~9k). rc_v / rc_tag get a +1 pin register (in_regs) in sw. Regions / landings otherwise as spec_q3_ar.json. XDIE-HBM4 parameters AR_ITER=1 / ROWS=128 on the q3 COLL quadrant parent (v8g/v8x 26a9b51eb): flat parent ot_hfd_coll_q3_lpf_ar (gen_coll_q2_lpf.py --ar-iter --rows 128 --suffix _ar); the v8g g_ariter flops are the leaf u_ariter (ot_hgi_coll_ariter_tag: clk_issue + clk_reduce[0], both region sw = the region of its readers u_reduce / u_control and its sources u_issuer / u_up*: no new landed crossing). Same regions / landings as lpk6. HBM COLL quadrant parent q3 (SW, ot_hfd_coll_q3_hard_v8x #(NLINK 2, TP 192), die instance hb_coll_SW; slot coll_SW). Same plan as q2 (spec_q2.json) plus the SOLO parts: argmax u_arg (source 9, reads switch sinks 10-13) joins sw (it is inside the capture->switch loop); the TKM interface is pins: tkx_* outputs from sw, tkx_w_* read only by the writer (wr, no landing), tkx_busy/done to the control leaf and tkx_fault to fj (sw). Regions: the qslots crossbar makes capture -> switch -> {control, link, reduce} -> capture a loop, and fj/issuer/upipe/vmasm feed it every edge, so all of them stay in ONE switch region (sw); the VM writer (TT insertion 251 ps vs 85-108 for the switch leaves, >100 ps apart) is its own region beside the VM banks (wr); ring A (ring_ag ctl + 8 state + 8 add lanes) reads and writes only boundary ports (gather master hcollgi_<q>, die ring lanes, SU) and is its own region on the ring face (rg) with NO landed data crossing. Child faults are sticky status (no reservation / valid / payload effect, fj header): ring_fault / writer_fault are landed but loose.
qid_rg_note: QF-COLLQ 10-18: qid_rg = the ring region's copy of the quadrant identity strap (N face beside u_rctl; die ties it to the same constant as qid). One S-face qid reached u_rctl.qid 1,146-1,200 um combinationally (textbook wire_reach REFUSE > 500 um); a strap is case-analysed, never landed, so each region gets its own pin.
qid_wr_note: TW-HBM-COLLP 10-19: qid_wr = the VM-writer region's copy of the quadrant identity strap (W face beside ck_wr / u_writer.sid; die ties it to the same constant as qid). One sw-owned qid fed u_writer.sid (kit OT_MULTI_ROOT: input qid has wrong domain for u_writer); a strap is case-analysed, never landed.
out_regs_note: TW2-COLLP 10-19: isa_lp_data = rc_d was a port -> port pass-through (SU -> gather master hcollgi_<q>); the landed standard / OT_MULTI_ROOT refuse an output with no region flop (lpk5 gate floorplan FAIL 'output isa_lp_data[0] has wrong or unregistered source domain rc_d[0]'). Registered on ck_sw (+1 edge); isa_ring gets the same +1 because hcollgi captures isa_ring and isa_lp_data on the same edge (ring-A merge register). COMPILER: every ISA ring-A command and its rc_d take effect 3 edges later than on v5 (was +2 on v8g); rc_* / SU bundle timing unchanged.
in_regs_note: COLLQ3 10-19: rc_v / rc_tag (SU -> COLL reduce-complete strobe + tag) were a combinational pin -> u_control path up to 540 um (ar128 gate textbook wire_reach REFUSE). One pin register in sw at the S face under u_control (pin x ~254 um, flop -> u_control rc pin ~324 um < 405). COMPILER: the die presents rc_v / rc_tag ONE edge earlier relative to every other COLL input (record input_port_offset_edges rc_* = other inputs - 1); rc_d / isa_lp_data unchanged. rc_d keeps the bundle: rc_d -> isa_lp_data gets out_regs 2 (was 1) so the SU rc bundle (rc_v, rc_tag, rc_d) is presented together, one edge earlier than the other COLL inputs, and isa_ring / isa_lp_data still leave on the SAME edge (hcollgi ring-A merge register; record output offsets isa_ring = isa_lp_data).

lag_pins.why: HBMb/COLL-LP 10-21: link0 rx (region lk) -> its capture slot (sw): the sw->lk->sw node loop (crossbar -> link wr / link rx -> capture) is broken here; the rx frame reaches the capture lag edges later = a longer die-to-die link latency the compiler schedules (record compiler lag)

HBMb/COLL-LP 10-21: link1 rx (region lk) -> its capture slot (sw): the sw->lk->sw node loop (crossbar -> link wr / link rx -> capture) is broken here; the rx frame reaches the capture lag edges later = a longer die-to-die link latency the compiler schedules (record compiler lag)

in_regs_note_1021: HBMb/COLL-LP 10-21: pin registers (SAFE item 1/2) on the far port buses of the 1.5 mm parent: inj_d (response, 1,024 b), vm_rr (2,056 b), tkx_busy/done/fault -- each port presented 1 edge earlier (record input_port_offset_edges).
out_regs_note_1021: HBMb/COLL-LP 10-21: one region register on every far output bus (delivery bundle del_valid/del_flit/hgi_del_obase, inj request inj_rd/inj_idx/hgi_inj_addr, vm_rq, stat_cycles, the whole tkx bundle) so each bundle stays aligned (+1 edge each, record output offsets).
regions_note_1021: HBMb/COLL-LP 10-21 (reach model scratch/hbmb-coll-lp/reach.py, child LEFs): one sw region holding issuer 518x432, 2 x link_e1 475x173, fj and the 28-child crossbar leaves 550-1250 um direct child/port wires in every floorplan (textbook wire_reach REFUSE > 500). Regions hd = {fj, issuer} (fj<->issuer loop stays inside) and lk = {links} are LANDED: issuer -> up / control / ports +3, sw -> link +3, link rx -> capture = lag pins; child faults -> fj loose (sticky status).
clock_ports_note_1021: new region clock ports ck_hd / ck_lk (die drops one clock per region, neighbour-matched)
regs2_note_1021: HBMb/COLL-LP 10-21: the delivery (del_valid/del_flit/hgi_del_obase) and injection (inj_rd/inj_idx/hgi_inj_addr out, inj_d in) bundles take TWO pin stages: their 3.5 k pins sit on the E face (the S/N/W faces are full at ~4 pins/um), up to ~1.2 mm from the crossbar; qid (static strap) read only by u_fj -> region hd.
